name: @egress/rmq-producer
description: The publisher SDK: an application names the Contract its messages follow; this declares the contract's exchange, writes each message in the contract's format, stamps its message_id, and publishes to the exchange in confirmed, mandatory batches, traced and counted. It knows no queue: each consumer binds its own. It shares the contract with @egress/rmq-consumer and nothing else, and never reads breaker state. packages/producer is the application written against it.
